description: An opaque navy floor-length gown has a low square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves, and extensive fine geometric gold-toned woven borders along the neck, sleeve cuffs, front panels, and hem. A cream underdress panel is visible down the center. Round ornamental shoulder brooches and a decorated belt fasten the outfit. A navy bordered wrap drapes along the forearms, and dark brown shoes appear beneath the skirt.
